preconditions: Identify the optional context, actual task and authorized catalog roots; reserve required instructions and dependencies separately.
Use nonnegative integer budget/pool/costs, a positive integer unit and finite relevance scores.
Bound the candidate set and DP capacity for available memory; relate token estimates to the actual tokenizer and remaining context.

expected_effects.effect: select_skills reads the catalog, ranks up to the requested pool and returns chosen/dropped shortlist references.
expected_effects.scope: SKILL.md contents under selected roots, lexical scores, returned paths/metadata and query text.
expected_effects.basis: skill_finder.load_catalog reads complete files and estimates tokens from characters; rank receives pool explicitly. Chosen indices distinguish candidates with identical display names.
expected_effects.impact: Consumes local file I/O and CPU; returned metadata may expose private paths or task context. Missing/unreadable roots and ranking filters can leave an incomplete candidate set.
expected_effects.verification: Use temporary catalogs with more than five candidates and homonyms; compare selected/dropped paths, catalog counts and original files.

expected_effects.effect: knapsack allocates DP tables and chooses items under rounded-up estimated costs.
expected_effects.scope: In-memory caller Item objects, effective capacity and returned indices/token/relevance totals.
expected_effects.basis: Each cost is max(1, ceil(tokens/unit)); capacity is floor(budget/unit), capped at summed weights. The solver is exact in that quantized space, not necessarily in original token costs.
expected_effects.impact: Quantization can omit items or combinations that fit the original budget. Small units and large pools/capacities increase CPU/memory; scores and token estimates do not prove task relevance.
expected_effects.verification: Compare small fixtures with exhaustive quantized search; test original-budget counterexamples and measure actual tokenizer/quality on representative target tasks.

expected_effects.effect: CLI/MCP output a selection proposal without executing a skill or modifying the catalog.
expected_effects.scope: Stdout or tool-result recipients and subsequent context-loading decisions.
expected_effects.basis: The module returns references, estimated totals, a comparison note and cloud_tokens=0. It makes no inference request and does not read chosen instructions into the consuming agent.
expected_effects.impact: A caller can mistake a shortlist or estimated reduction for verified applicability, complete context or measured savings.
expected_effects.verification: Inspect complete selected instructions, prerequisites, exclusions and effects before execution; verify actual downstream content and tokenizer usage.

downstream_effects.effect: A consuming agent may omit mandatory context or execute a similarly named but unsuitable operation.
downstream_effects.scope: Later model context, selected tool calls and dependent workflow steps.
downstream_effects.basis: Lexical ranking, pool limits and quantized packing have no required-item, dependency or exclusion-group constraint.
downstream_effects.impact: Missing instructions or prerequisites can propagate incorrect decisions even when the numeric budget is respected.
downstream_effects.verification: Reserve required context outside selection; compare each candidate operation with the task and verify prerequisites before dependent steps.

downstream_effects.effect: Recomputing against changed catalogs can produce a different plan despite an unchanged task.
downstream_effects.basis: Catalog text, root contents, descriptions and estimates are loaded afresh; the module retains no immutable snapshot or persistent run identity.
downstream_effects.impact: Names alone can conceal changed paths or instructions, making reuse or comparisons unreliable.
downstream_effects.verification: Retain authorized query/settings, catalog revisions and full candidate references with the downstream evidence.

reversibility.strategy: Discard or recompute the proposal and restore necessary full context; reconcile actions already performed by consumers separately.
residual_effects: Captured metadata or task text can remain with output recipients.
Local recomputation cannot undo downstream actions based on omitted or unsuitable instructions.

retry.check_before_retry: The module has no intended persistent writes, but a retry reads current files and repeats compute. Confirm catalog/version and settings before treating results as the same proposal.
retry.stop_condition: Resolve unsuitable roots, invalid cost parameters, excessive capacity or missing mandatory context before relying on another selection.

required_scope: Existing task authority for reading the selected catalog roots and disclosing returned metadata/query. Selection grants no authority to execute candidates or remove mandatory instructions.

analysis.summary: Deterministic lexical selection and quantized packing create an advisory shortlist. Numeric feasibility is scoped to estimates; correct operation choice and complete instructions remain the consuming agent responsibility.
uncertainties: The finder uses approximate character-based costs and lexical matching, and can omit unreadable files or below-threshold candidates.
Reading catalog text is not semantic verification or a trusted-source check; follow referenced instructions only within the existing task scope.
Imported skill_finder behavior, tokenizer/context overhead, linked resources and runtime state are outside these local source bindings.
There is no complete observation adapter, immutable catalog snapshot or automatic dependency resolution.

reuse.target: Shortlist optional documents for another constrained agent workflow.
reuse.rationale: Item costs/scores and root/pool settings can be supplied and tested independently of inference.
adaptations: Preserve mandatory context separately and use target-tokenizer estimates including linked instructions.
Bind comparisons to catalog revisions and paths; check each selected operation against suitable cases and exclusions.
reuse.validation: Compare selection, instruction retention and independently verified task results against full-context baselines on representative tasks, including homonyms and quantization boundaries.
